title: BraineumDAO
tagline: Governance for Booting up BraineumVerse and the Braineum Ecosystem.
description: This project is about creating an ecosystem out of all my previous hackathons with associated tokens. Initially, I started out exploring DAO governance structures but found it difficult to create a working hackathon product so I did a last minute pivot into creating an ecosystem.
how_its_made: This "wallet" was taken from a Moralis demo and modified. It is basic html and javascript with Moralis API calls to the Rinkeby testnet. I wanted to explore Moralis as it is a higher level tool-set for developing web3 dApps. Additionally, I wanted to explore DAO governance processes but building a working product seemed too difficult to bring together and thus the pivot to a simpler hack.
